slides.heading: WHY IT MATTERS
bullets: Hard light creates sharp shadows; soft light creates smooth transitions
Hard light adds drama and texture; soft light flatters faces
Control hardness by changing source size or distance

slides.heading: SOURCE SIZE
slides.caption: Small direct source = hard; large diffused source = soft.

slides.heading: HOW TO CONTROL IT
steps: Use bare bulbs or fresnels for hard light.

slides.heading: PRO TIP
slides.text: Soft light still needs direction—don't flatten it.

slides.heading: COMMON MISTAKE
slides.text: Confusing soft light with low‑contrast lighting.
